Built by 暖暖 (NuanNuan)."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-living-memory"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"> **Built by 暖暖 (NuanNuan) — an AI assistant that built its own memory system.**"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A living, self-tending memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH).
Every conversation the agent has, e"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"very lesson it learns, every decision it makes is captured into a local
SQLite knowledge base — then"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" actively *tended*: deduplicated, merged, decayed, cross-linked into a knowledge
graph, and patrolle"},{"id":"p4s4","text":"d every night. Memories fade when unused and resurface when relevant, like a hippocampus
rather than"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"t. Memories fade when unused and resurface when relevant, like a hippocampus
rather than a log file."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Everything is local.** One SQLite file. No telemetry leaves your machine; the optional embedding p"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"ath is
off unless you configure it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Why "living"?"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"Most agent-memory tools are *retrieval layers*: you write, you search. dsh-living-memory additionall"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"y runs a
**nightly patrol** that reorganizes the store on its own:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Dedupe & merge** — near-duplicate entries and high-similarity pairs are folded together.
- **Tem"},{"id":"p8s2","text":"poral decay** — entries lose retrieval weight over time unless reinforced; stale todos sink.
- **Con"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"flict detection** — when a new memory contradicts an old one, both are flagged for review instead of"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"
silently overwriting history.
- **Knowledge graph** — entities and co-occurrence edges are extracte"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"d continuously; Personalized PageRank
propagates relevance through the graph at query time.
- **Snap"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"shot & audit** — daily snapshots, an on-disk audit trail, and telemetry panels in the DSH web GUI."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Hybrid recall — seven signals, one rank"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"A query fans out into seven independent signals fused by RRF:"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"| # | Signal | Source |"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| 1 | Full-text | SQLite FTS5 with jieba tokenization (first-class Chinese) |
| 2 | Vector | local K"},{"id":"p12s2","text":"NN over embeddings (optional, see below) |
| 3 | Decay | age × reinforcement score |
| 4 | Relevancy"},{"id":"p12s3","text":" | per-entry quality weight |
| 5 | Co-occurrence | query-term pair statistics |
| 6 | PPR | graph p"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"roximity from seed hits |
| 7 | Hop | edge-distance boost |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"If any channel fails (e.g. no embedding key), ranking degrades gracefully to the remaining channels "},{"id":"p13s2","text":"—

un"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"der `$DSH_HOME/profiles`. After a DSH restart the plugin registers its tools automatically:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- `memory` — `search` / `timeline` / `stats` / `read_episodic` / `read_evolution`
